en.title: Hong Kong Fintech Week x StartmeupHK 2026 Main Forum: Exploring New Opportunities with Finance Plus, AI Plus, and Global Expansion
en.summary: The Hong Kong Fintech Week x StartmeupHK 2026 marks its 11th edition. The event highlights new opportunities through finance, AI, and global expansion.
en.impact: This event could provide insights for technology users and developers interested in financial technology and artificial intelligence developments in the region.
keyPoints: Hong Kong Fintech Week x StartmeupHK 2026 enters its 11th edition.
The forum focuses on finance plus, AI plus, and global expansion.
